history.sg_progress: The Administration has supported and will continue to support entities in integrating UNDP-administered staff into the United Nations Secretariat. The Administration has reached out to all entities of the Secretariat that have personnel administered by UNDP and is collecting information on the planned transitions. The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime and OHCHR have started the transition of their personnel, with the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime planning to have finalized the process in November 2023. The Administration has also drafted a guide for the processing of such transitions to assist entities in the process. Consultations on the guide are currently being conducted among stakeholders.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to support entities in expediting the process of integrating UNDP- administered staff into the Secretariat in a progressive and seamless manner with due regard to ensuring transparency and fairness of the selection process, in accordance with the Organization’s regulatory framework.
history.administration_response: The Human Resources Services Division engaged with entities to establish a list of current staff administered by UNDP on behalf of the United Nations Secretariat. As of December 2023, there were 2,100 such staff members remaining in the Department of Global Communications, the Department of Safety and Security, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights, the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development, the United Nations Environment Programme, the United Nations Human Settlements Programme and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime. The Human Resources Services Division – in coordination with the Office of Human Resources, the Office of the Controller and the Payroll and Accounts Payable Section – developed a process guide for entities to transfer staff from UNDP to United Nations Secretariat administration by means of the so called “lift/shift” modality. The process guide included a sample project plan and templates for data gathering and verification and was shared with entities in November 2023. The transition for staff in the Office for Disarmament Affairs was completed in 2023. The transition for the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime was started, and the first batch was moved with completion planned for June 2024. The transition for the Office of the United Nations Commissioner for Human Rights was also started and four staff members were moved. A further proposal for the Office as well as transition plans for the Department of Safety and Security and the United Nations Centre for Human Settlements are currently under review for approval by the relevant stakeholders.
history.board_assessment: Given that the proposal is under review, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: The Department of Operational Support encouraged entities to establish a list of current staff administered by UNDP on behalf of the United Nations Secretariat. As of December 2023, 2,100 of those staff remained in the Department of Safety and Security, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, the United Nations Office of Drugs and Crime, UNEP, UN-Habitat, the Department of Global Communications, the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development. The Department of Operational Support, in coordination with the Office of Human Resources and the Office of the Controller, developed a process guide for entities to transfer staff from UNDP to the United Nations Secretariat administration through the so called “lift and shift” modality. The process guide included a sample project plan and templates for data gathering and verification and was shared with entities in November 2023. The Administration provided extensive training to all relevant entities and provided them with a process guide, a data conversion manual that explains how to record the relevant data conversion personnel action manually in Umoja and templates for the lift and shift modality. On the basis of the above, the Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to support entities in expediting the process of integrating UNDP- administered staff into the Secretariat in a progressive and seamless manner, with due regard to ensuring the transparency and fairness of the selection process, in accordance with the Organization’s regulatory framework.
history.administration_response: The Human Resources Services Division of the Department of Operational Support has submitted a process guide, job aid and templates as evidence in support of the closure of this recommendation, and notes that the Division lacks the authority to mandate entities to integrate UNDP- administered staff, given that it remains a strategic decision under the authority of each head of entity. Any proposal by a head of entity to integrate and transition UNDP-administered staff also requires review by the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance (Office of Human Resources and Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget). Accordingly, the Human Resources Services Division has completed all the tasks necessary to facilitate the implementation of this recommendation and, under its regular mandate, will continue to support entities with guidance and operational support upon request.
history.board_assessment: Given that the process guide has been released, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
